rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for restoring or upgrading something so it looks and works like new.

example.english: We refurbish the old computer, and it runs much faster now.
example.traditional: 我哋將部舊電腦翻新，依家快咗好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 faan1 san1 ji1 gaa1 faai3 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for refurbishing a room, flat, house, shop, or other premises, especially through interior work.

example.english: We plan to refurbish the shop so it will be brighter and tidier.
example.traditional: 我哋打算裝修間舖，等個環境光猛啲、企理啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 zong1 sau1 gaan1 pou3 dang2 go3 waan4 ging2 gwong1 maang5 di1 kei5 lei5 di1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on restoring something damaged to working order rather than updating its appearance.

example.english: The technician says we can refurbish the old machine instead of replacing it.
example.traditional: 師傅話修復部舊機就得，唔使換新。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 waa6 sau1 fuk6 bou6 gau6 gei1 zau6 dak1 m4 sai2 wun6 san1
